programs.title: Destination Special
programs.desc: Explore Turkey. Situated between Europe and Asia, Turkey is fascinating for its cultural richness and its well preserved environmental heritage. A land full of history, refined cuisine, one of the most beautiful cities in the world, and landscapes alternating between white sand beaches and majestic summits for guaranteed breathtaking scenery.
